tour.title: Guided tour

team.title: Create and set up your team
team.desc: In My team you set the name, logo and sport, and open or close registrations for new players.

members.title: Manage your players
members.desc: In Members you approve join requests, assign roles such as co-captain and remove players.

calendar.title: Plan the activity
calendar.desc: In Calendar you create trainings, matches and tournaments, including multi-day events.

callups.title: Call up your team
callups.desc: When a call-up is required, players get notified and you pick who plays and the pairs per court.

results.title: Record results
results.desc: After the match enter the sets per court: TeamUp works out the winner and updates the stats.

chat.title: Keep everyone talking
chat.desc: Create private channels, invite by link and keep the team informed from Communications.

find.title: Find your team
find.desc: Search teams with open registrations and send your request; the captain gets notified.

calendar.title: Check the calendar
calendar.desc: See every training, match and tournament in weekly or monthly view.

signup.title: Sign up for call-ups
signup.desc: Open a call-up, check date, time and venue, then confirm or cancel your participation.

polls.title: Vote in polls
polls.desc: Answer availability, schedule or team decision polls before the deadline.

badges.title: Earn achievements
badges.desc: Attendance, wins and streaks unlock badges and place you on the team leaderboard.

alerts.title: Never miss a thing
alerts.desc: Turn on reminders and notifications to stay on top of call-ups and last-minute changes.
